title: A notification moves its workspace to the top of the sidebar (notifications.attention.moveToTop, on by default since 2026-11-09). Four workspaces with Delta at the bottom; a cmux notify from Delta's terminal while Alpha shows moves it up to the top of the unpinned rows. Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/sidebar-notified-to-top.json

steps.title: Workspace Delta (made first, so new workspaces push it to the bottom)
Before the notification: Delta is the bottom row
Show Alpha: the user looks at Alpha
Delta's own terminal posts a notification while the user looks at Alpha
cmux: cmux notify --title 'Build finished' --body 'Delta is ready for review' --desktop false

steps.title: Press Return to run cmux notify in Delta
Sidebar after the notification: Delta moves to the top with its unread mark (on); Delta stays at the bottom (off)
